body: The world is digital. We believe your workplace should be, too. We help you define what modern work means for you and the strategy needed to support your journey.
An interactive gaming experience that puts Microsoft Copilot and Azure Open AI to the test in a thrilling time-travel mission.
Create hybrid experiences
Automate business processes
Put your employees first, create interactions and engage people. We create successful hybrid working experiences.
We design and implement new suitable and intelligent solutions to support work in mobility
We take care of the migration to the cloud of corporate/business apps so you can securely access them from anywhere, at anytime
We help you engage people via digital platforms combined with specific formats to improve employee experience, productivity, and innovation
We redesign training, making it more fun and engaging to better support new ways of working and managing processes and tools
We help internal communications to promptly reach the right audience with a multi-channel approach
A large-scale Microsoft 365 Copilot deployment that redefined collaboration and organisational efficiency.

Valorem Reply helped a leading retail pharmacy scale Microsoft Copilot adoption from 100 to 11,100 employees, empowering teams to integrate AI into everyday workflows and drive productivity across the organization.

WM Reply, in partnership with the Care Quality Commission (CQC), earned Silver at the 2025 Internal Communications and Engagement Awards for ‘HOME,’ a Microsoft 365-powered intranet that has transformed employee experience, accessibility, and engagement for over 3,000 colleagues.
A Cluster Reply Digital Workplace solution that offers all the advantages of a technology based on Microsoft 365 systems.
TamTamy™ is an Enterprise Social Network solution to respond to the need – B2B and B2C – for communication, collaboration and learning.
Accelerator 365 apps and solutions are designed to deliver a personal, engaging and informative corporate intranet in no time.
Our framework for automated, digital and intelligent, input management.
Discovery Reply™ is a platform for Digital Experience Management. A digital asset management tool used for communication and team collaboration.
Workspace Reservation Tool is an easy to use application for desk, parking and meeting room reservations.
Improve your way of working and automate your processes.
Discover how Unipol Group uses Process Intelligence, AI and advanced analytics to gain end-to-end visibility, improve processes and support data-driven decisions.

A securities loan in 15 minutes with just a few clicks: this is what the innovative automation solution from a leading service provider in the banking and securities sector makes possible for neo-brokers. The innovative framework is a first step towards generative RPA.

Cloud services not only make it possible to optimize the flexibility, scalability, and cost efficiency of Robotic Process Automation. They also open up completely new application opportunities. Our whitepaper shows how that works.
